name: Deep hot upflow
supporting_observation: W10 Tmax 268.7 degC at -250 mRL; W2 Tmax 266.9 degC at -550 mRL; W10 regime upflow (no inversion, shallow gradient 692 degC/km). [obs] The two hottest wells lie in the same corner of the field; the upflow itself is inferred from their temperature and the absence of an inversion at W10.

name: Lateral outflow along the section line
supporting_observation: W2 inversion 30.9 degC from -550 to -1500 mRL; W3 inversion 86.9 degC from -450 to -1700 mRL; W6 inversion 98.1 degC from -550 to -1900 mRL. [obs] Hottest water at the top of the inversion, cooler water below it.

name: Lateral outflow away from the section line (direction inferred)
supporting_observation: W5 Tmax 158.0 degC at -650 mRL with inversion 13.3 degC; W7 Tmax 176.7 degC at -650 mRL with inversion 46.0 degC; W9 Tmax 217.7 degC at -750 mRL with inversion 57.7 degC. [obs] Each well off the line shows the same hot-over-cool profile; the flow direction is not measured.

name: Cold recharge or downflow
supporting_observation: W4 Tmax 29.0 degC, T at TD 29.0 degC at -750 mRL; W8 Tmax 93.1 degC, T at TD 93.1 degC at -2716 mRL. [obs] Whole surveyed column below 100 degC.

name: Cap (conductive gradient, low permeability)
supporting_observation: W6: surface 160 mRL, 200 degC at -329 mRL, shallow gradient 490 degC/km; W3: surface 180 mRL, 200 degC at -14 mRL, shallow gradient 680 degC/km; W10: surface 260 mRL, 200 degC at 46 mRL, shallow gradient 692 degC/km; W2: surface 260 mRL, 200 degC at -81 mRL, shallow gradient 622 degC/km. [obs] Steep, near-linear temperature rise from the surface to the 200 degC level.

name: Near-boiling zone (not two-phase: margin above 1 degC)
supporting_observation: W10 minimum margin 2.65 degC at -150 mRL. [obs] Temperature follows boiling-point-for-depth to within 5 degC.
